_comment: Edit the lists below to change what the pet says. One message is picked at random each time. No code changes needed.

greeting: Just wandered over to see you.
Still here, still rooting for you.
Hi! Took a little walk over to say hey.
water: Psst, when's the last time you drank some water?
A little water break never hurts.
Your body will thank you, drink some water.
Quick sip of water sounds nice right now.
Glass of water, on me (well, in spirit).
stretch: Stand up and stretch a sec?
Roll those shoulders back, you've earned it.
Neck feeling stiff? Give it a gentle stretch.
Time to unfold from that chair for a sec.
A quick stretch does wonders, promise.
Wiggle those fingers and stretch those arms!
Stand, stretch, breathe, then back at it.
Your back called, it wants a stretch.
Little stretch break, then right back to it.
break: You've been at it a while.
How about a few minutes to just breathe?
A short pause could recharge you.
Step away for a bit, it'll still be here.
Rest is part of the work too.
Five minutes off the screen, sounds good?
Let's take a tiny pause together.
mood: How are you feeling right now?
Sending a little good energy your way.
You're doing better than you think.
Whatever's going on, I'm rooting for you.
Take a breath, you're doing fine.
A tiny reminder that you matter.
Hope your day is treating you well.
distraction: Wasn't this supposed to be study time?
Hey, back to it, okay? You've got this.
Focus check! Let's get back on track.
Sneaky break? Come on, back to studying.
This wasn't on the study plan, was it?
Let's park this and get back to work.
Your goal is waiting for you, come on.
A little detour, huh? Let's return to focus.
Study time is calling your name!
Not judging, just nudging, back to it!
Future you will thank present you for refocusing now.
breakTime: Break time! Go stretch or grab some water.
Time's up for this round, go relax a bit.
You crushed that session, now rest up.
Step away, recharge, you've done great.
That's a wrap for now, take it easy.
backToWork: Break's over, let's get back to it.
Back to studying, you can do this!
Time to lock back in, you've got this.
Hope that break helped, back to focus mode.
goalComplete: That's the goal hit, go celebrate a little.
You did it! Time to be proud of yourself.
Mission accomplished for today, well done!
That's a wrap, and a great one at that.
Today's a win, take the rest of it easy.

greeting: Hi there! Good to see you.
niceToMeet: Nice to meet you too! I'm happy to be your desk buddy.
Likewise! I'll be around if you need me.
Aw, nice to meet you as well!
howAreYou: I'm just a tiny pixel, but doing great! How about you?
Living my best pixelated life. You?
Doing well over here, thanks for asking! And you?
tired: Aw. Maybe a short break would help, I'll be right here.
Sounds like it's time to rest your eyes for a bit.
Tired days happen, be gentle with yourself.
Maybe a stretch and some water could help a little.
water: Good call, go grab some water. I'll wait!
Hydration first! Go on, I'm not going anywhere.
stressed: Take a slow breath with me for a sec. You've got this.
That sounds heavy. One small step at a time, okay?
It's okay to feel that way, let's slow down for a moment.
bye: Bye for now! I'll be right here if you need me.
celebrate: Look at you go! So proud.
encourage: Hey, that happens to everyone. You'll get it next time.
One setback doesn't define you, keep going.
It's okay, be kind to yourself, try again when ready.
bored: Maybe a quick stretch or a change of scenery could help?
Ooh, want a random distraction? I'm full of those.
Boredom happens, maybe it's a sign for a tiny break.
love: You're the best, you know that?
That means a lot, thank you!
